trends.name: US-Iran Military Escalation
trends.summary: US fighter jet downed over Iran with one crew member rescued; escalating tensions with potential supply chain and geopolitical risk implications. Wall Street preparing for longer-term disruption and rotating into oil-and-gas producers. Iranian retaliation risks create volatility headwinds for markets.

trends.name: March Jobs Report Mixed Signals
trends.summary: 178,000 March payroll gains beat expectations, but February revised down sharply to -133,000 job loss. Fed officials signaling slower labor force growth normalizes lower job gains. Labor market showing structural weakness despite headline beat, creating confusion on Fed policy direction.

trends.name: Fed Policy Pivot On Hold
trends.summary: One-year inflation expectations exceed 5% while rate hike odds rising, offsetting earlier Fed pivot expectations. Weaker February jobs data and inflation pressures create stagflation concerns. Rate cut timeline pushed further out, pressuring equities and bonds.

trends.name: Magnificent 7 Underperformance
trends.summary: All Mag 7 stocks down YTD with performance turning less impressive despite earnings growth still leading S&P 493. Market breadth deteriorating as mega-cap tech loses leadership. Potential rotation away from concentrated big-tech positions threatens 2024-2025 rally foundation.

trends.name: Trump Budget Defense Spending Surge
trends.summary: Trump administration proposes $1 trillion spending increase over 2025 with historic defense spending boost. Defense contractors and related ETFs positioned for multi-year tailwinds. Fiscal expansion creates inflation and debt concerns, offsetting some equity gains.

trends.name: Section 230 Legal Shield Under Attack
trends.summary: Meta and Google facing court cases challenging 30-year-old Section 230 immunity from user-generated liability. Regulatory headwinds could increase content moderation costs and legal exposure. Significant long-term implications for big tech valuations and business models.

trends.name: Worker Sentiment Collapse & Labor Stress
trends.summary: Gallup finds 49% of US workers struggling vs 46% thriving for first time ever, signaling weakening consumer confidence. Combined with high gas prices ($4+) and wage growth concerns, consumer spending pressure mounting. Risks to retail earnings and economic growth trajectory.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Momentum Building
trends.summary: Investor enthusiasm for SpaceX IPO countdown accelerating amid space industry tailwinds and defense spending growth. Retail and institutional demand suggests strong opening potential. Long-term space economy play tied to government funding and satellite demand.

trends.name: Supply Chain Shocks & Aluminum Disruption
trends.summary: EGA resuming Abu Dhabi aluminum output may take up to a year due to regional disruptions. Energy costs and geopolitical tensions threatening commodity supply stability. Inflationary pressures in metals and industrial materials amid Iran conflict and Beirut strikes.

trends.name: Agentic AI Beneficiaries Rally
trends.summary: Salesforce upgraded to Buy and Snowflake to Speculative Buy on agentic AI and data cloud potential. Software and cloud infrastructure seeing analyst upgrades as enterprises deploy autonomous AI systems. Sector outperformance play on AI monetization thesis.

trends.name: Reed Hastings Stock Wealth Surge
trends.summary: Netflix co-founder Reed Hastings made $500M+ on stock options since last year amid streaming recovery. Reflects Netflix stock strength and insider confidence. Streaming sector momentum as content spending discipline drives margin expansion.

trends.name: Energy & Commodity Sector Reversal
trends.summary: Oil-and-gas producers lagging in recent years seeing renewed investor interest amid Iran tensions and supply concerns. Freehold Royalties and energy sector plays gaining traction. Geopolitical premium and inflation hedge driving mean reversion in beaten-down energy names.
